name: @ariadne/desktop
description: Ariadne Studio as a desktop app: an Electron window around the same server the ariadne-studio CLI runs.
author: Ezekiel

scripts.dist: pnpm --filter @ariadne/desktop... build && tsx build.ts --stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: pnpm --filter @ariadne/desktop... build && tsx build.ts --stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
